name: Maximiliano Hernández Martínez
role: President of El Salvador from 1931 to 1934 and 1935 to 1944
contribution: A Salvadoran military officer and politician who served as the 27th president of El Salvador from 4 December 1931 to 28 August 1934 in a provisional capacity and again in an official capacity from 1 March 1935 until his resignation on 9 May 1944.
legacy: The 1931 coup and this person's succession to the presidency allowed for the rise of a series of military dictatorships that held onto power in El Salvador until 1979.

checks.lead: Maximiliano Hernández Martínez (21 October 1882 – 15 May 1966) was a Salvadoran military officer and politician who served as the 27th president of El Salvador from 4 December 1931 to 28 August 1934 in a provisional capacity and again in an official capacity from 1 March 1935 until his resignation on 9 May 1944. Martínez was the leader of El Salvador during most of World War II.
